headline: Executive order creates a group of federal agencies to coordinate energy development and permit decisions in Alaska.
what_it_does: This order sets up an interagency working group made up of federal agencies. The group's job is to coordinate how the government handles domestic energy development and permitting in Alaska. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies take part and what specific tasks the group has are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle energy and permits in Alaska
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to work together through a shared working group on Alaska energy projects and permits.

who_it_affects.group: Energy companies seeking to develop projects in Alaska
who_it_affects.how: The federal permit process they go through may be coordinated across agencies by this group.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 12, 2011; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
